characters.name: The Mogul
characters.text: In secret-bid auctions, your bid counts as $10 higher than it is when bids are compared, and you win ties. You still pay your real bid. When two players roll dice against each other and tie, you win the tie.

characters.name: The Hustler
characters.text: Once per lap, when you roll to move, you may roll one of your dice again. Your Stadium pick triples rent instead of doubling it. Your free Casino chip is 50% bigger.

characters.name: The Commuter
characters.text: Start the game with 3 Momentum tokens instead of 2. Your token limit is 4 instead of 2, and you can Nudge up to 4 spaces (1 token per space).

characters.name: The Lawyer
characters.text: You never pay Jail bail (leaving early is free). When you're sent to Jail, you still collect half the GO salary. You can't be targeted by Audit.

characters.name: The Politician
characters.text: Vote contracts: only you can lobby at the City Council, and before each vote the other players bid to pay you to vote their way. The highest offer wins; if you take it, the money is yours and you must vote that way. Every dollar you take or lobby adds 2 influence to your vote. Landing on City Hall fills your Momentum tokens. Fundraising: when an Event or Opportunity card gives you money, the bank gives you the same again.

characters.name: The City Planner
characters.text: At game start, secretly look at 1 hidden Government tile of your choice. Each time you pass GO, secretly look at 1 more that is still hidden. After each look, you may swap that tile for a random one that isn't in play, before anyone else finds out what it was. You never pay Government tile fees. Once per game, after a City Council vote is rolled, you may reverse the result.

characters.name: The Medic
characters.text: If you're sent to the Hospital, you pay no bill and roll normally on your next turn. Insured markers are free for you. When anyone else pays a Hospital bill or buys an Insured marker, the money goes to you instead of the bank.
